title: Implicit enumeration machine
statement: The machine has one Boolean work tape and states `ask`, `bit`, `emitT`, `emitF`, `incC`, `incB`, and `done`, and starts in `ask`. In states `emitT` and `emitF` it outputs true and false, respectively, and moves to `incC`; in states `incC` and `incB` its transitions are given by the increment actions used in its definition, and in every other case it halts without output.
hypotheses_covered: Transitions from emitT and emitF output the corresponding Boolean and move to incC
Transitions from incC and incB use the referenced increment actions
All remaining transitions halt without output
caveat: The definitions of the increment actions are absent from the supplied statement, so their behavior cannot be described precisely.
